name: co-VC Dimension of Common-Core Singletons
proof: Projecting away the common coordinate gives the $n$ singleton class. Its absent all-zero trace has all $n$ one-coordinate flips present, giving a hollow $n$-star and hence $\mathrm{coVC}\geq n$. Conversely every projection of $\mathcal C^{\cap}_n$ has at most $n$ distinct concepts, while a hollow $d$-star has $d$ distinct realized leaves. Therefore no projection has co-VC dimension above $n$.
